__README__: Copy this file to entitymap.json (same folder) and fill it in. It maps address-less landlord/agent entity names — the ones that appear on a statement without a street address the matcher can resolve — to the portfolio building name(s) they cover. Keys are matched case-insensitively as substrings of the statement's entity/label; values are building names EXACTLY as they appear in the buildings table. entitymap.json is git-ignored (office-maintained, local only). Delete this __README__ key in your real file.
